name: hotreload-hx
description: Hot reload for Haxe JavaScript programs, in the browser or node: save a .hx file and the running program switches to the new code without losing its state.
releasenote: Every static keeps its value, and @:hot is deprecated. Static callbacks, enum constants, Map keys, Sets and workers now reload. A reload reports edits it cannot bring in, and survives failing hooks and bad builds. Defines and metadata are registered with Haxe. Reloader.update, watchAssets and dispose are removed. hxcpp/cppia support is frozen on the hxcpp branch.
